remarks: Charming Spanish-style single-family home. The interior has been updated to maximize comfort, featuring Nest-controlled central A/C, double-pane windows throughout, and a convenient full size laundry area. Outside, beautifully landscaped with fruit trees (lemon and avocado) and a shaded gazebo. This property is ideally located in the desirable Beverlywood vicinity and Reynier Village, just a short distance from the charming Reynier Park. Its proximity to Culver City, only minutes away, adds significant, offering easy access to a vibrant array of shops, restaurants, entertainment venues, and major freeways.
